lcc_original: 上帝看看他一切所造的都很好。有晚上有早晨，是第六日。
notes: UNV 神→LCC 上帝: systematic Elohim rendering difference (WH0430 attaches to 上帝)
UNV 看著→LCC 看看: LCC uses verb reduplication for the same Hebrew רָאָה; WH07200+WTH8799 attach to 看看
LCC adds pronoun 他 before 一切 with no Hebrew counterpart; direct object marker {WAH0853} kept implicit and placed after verb cluster
{WAH02009} (הִנֵּה, behold) has no explicit LCC equivalent; kept implicit after 的
UNV 甚→LCC 很: both render מְאֹד (exceedingly); WH03966 attaches to 很
